fields.evmodel: format version of the intent document (1)
fields.parts: adjectives, numbers and relationships per part
fields.colours: colour per region as quoted "#rrggbb" (sRGB), overriding the template's
fields.must: hard tests every result must pass
fields.match: reference silhouettes or meshes per view
fields.explore: search effort: auto or a level
fields.return: how many candidates make returns (1 to 8)
fields.seed: seed for sampling, noise and jitter

classes.kart: a go-kart: chassis, nose, side pods, bumper, engine, wing, seat, steering and four wheels
classes.character_body: a stylized character body without face detail
classes.character: a full character in a T-pose: layered body, garments, hair, accessories, skeleton, colour regions
classes.building: a building: walls, roof, door and windows
classes.tree: a tree: trunk, branches and canopy
classes.fence: a fence section: posts, rails and pickets
classes.crate: a wooden crate with slats and braces
classes.lamp_post: a street lamp: base, pole, arm and lamp
classes.bench: a park bench with seat, back and leg frames
classes.door: a door leaf in its frame
classes.chest: a chest with a lid, bands and a lock
classes.sword: a sword: blade, guard, grip and pommel
classes.shield: a shield: face, rim, boss and straps
classes.lollipop: a lollipop: candy disc on a stick
classes.candy_cane: a candy cane: shaft and hook
classes.mushroom: a mushroom: stem and cap (benchmark template)
classes.cactus: a cactus: trunk and arms (benchmark template)

styles.toon_chunky: chunky toon proportions on the toon look: big masses, generous bevels, no thin edges (draft, uncalibrated)

regions.contact: where parts touch the ground or each other

fit_box.means: the bounding box lies inside [length, width, height]

clear.means: two parts keep at least a gap

swing_clear.means: a moving part clears the rest over its arc

wheels_clear_chassis_at_steer.means: front wheels clear the body when steered

seats.means: a body fits the driver seat

stands.means: rests on the ground with a stable footprint (or none)

connected.means: one solid unless parts are marked loose

relationships.flush_with: a face level with another part's face
relationships.array_along: repeated along a line or curve

generators.noise_rock: a rock from blended noisy ellipsoids
generators.layer: a garment shell over other parts: grown by a thickness, kept in bands, cut open, optionally draped as a skirt
